children: Japanese government bond yields are lower following declines in U.S. Treasury yields overnight. Drops in domestic stocks and uncertainty over French debt woes are bolstering demand for JGBs. Investors are focusing on developments in the French bond market as well as the pace of potential Bank of Japan rate increases. Government data showed Friday that Japanese consumer prices, excluding fresh food, climbed 2.1% in September from a year earlier, compared with August's 1.7% rise, keeping expectations intact for another rate increase by end-year. The 10-year JGB yield is 9 bps lower at 2.790%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
